Data-driven observations

    Filtered data explorer

    Data handling: The source dataset is preserved in memory as loaded. The dashboard trims surrounding whitespace in text values and converts clearly numeric values where possible; missing values are not imputed. Repeated company IDs are allowed because records are company-year observations. Negative margins or growth may be valid. Outliers are displayed, not automatically removed. Check business definitions and units before interpreting monetary or environmental totals.
    Built with Plotly.js, Papa Parse and SheetJS. These libraries are loaded from CDNs, so an internet connection is required. Data analysis runs in your browser; uploaded files are not sent to a backend by this dashboard.
